title: Ricardo Gill — Persistent agents and temporal memory
author: Ricardo Gill
research_status: Direct methodological fit; comparative performance untested

finder_profile.audience: Persistent agents and temporal memory researchers, developers and evaluators
finder_profile.required_capability: Read original sources, design controlled tests, retain provenance and distinguish proposals from findings.

possible_application: Prototype a memory layer with separate event time, archive receipt time, actor-access assertions and source provenance. Preserve contemporaneous and reconstructed evidence views rather than overwriting earlier records.
illustrative_example: An email received before a decision is archived later. Preserve both times and the evidence supporting historical receipt.
evaluation_targets: Historical-state reconstruction accuracy, temporal leakage, retrieval recall and provenance completeness.
requested_contribution: Read, test, adapt or critique the authored research; report methods, source version, comparisons, results and limitations.
source_relation: Related sources establish background problems or methods, not independent validation or endorsement of GCI.
